evidence.quote: Our opening term sheet provides a $32 million class fund and separate fees and expenses, subject to court approval.
Any reduction in the approved fee would go to the class.

summary: Hargrove Lane raised fees alongside class relief in its opening proposal, and the parties negotiated both before agreeing on the class fund. The term directing any fee reduction to the class links the fee award to class recovery, but the transcript does not show a fee-for-fund trade, exploitation of counsel’s fee interest, or misleading court declaration.
